product_metadata.title: Bon Brasserie 20-Piece Stainless Steel Flatware Silverware Cutlery Set - Red in Petite Size, Include Knife/Fork/Spoon, Dishwasher Safe, Service for 4
features: High grade 18/0 stainless steel, 1.5/1.2mm thickness, and matt polished. Finely made with a delightful classic handle, and comfortable to hold
Set includes 4 dinner knives( 21.2cm long), 4 dinner forks (19cm long), 4 dinner spoons (18.5cm long), 4 salad forks( 16cm long) and 4 teaspoons( 16cm long)

Dishwasher safe and rust-resistant. Care Instructions:The flatware set is dishwasher safe under a temperature of 60 Celsius (°C). For best results, do not leave the set soaking for a long period of time. Dry promptly after cleaning. Lemon detergent is not recommended as it may cause erosion.
Presented in a mail box, ideal for daily use, and also a good gift
